heading.zh-Hant: 出身與威爾斯親王時期
heading.en: Birth and years as Prince of Wales

body.zh-Hant: 愛德華七世1841年11月9日生於白金漢宮，是維多利亞女王與亞伯特親王的長子；同年12月8日受封威爾斯親王。1863年3月10日他與丹麥公主亞歷山德拉結婚。在母親在位期間，他承擔一些公共職責，但直到1898年才獲准代行女王職務。
body.en: Edward VII was born at Buckingham Palace on 9 November 1841, the eldest son of Queen Victoria and Prince Albert, and was created Prince of Wales on 8 December 1841. On 10 March 1863 he married the Danish Princess Alexandra. During his mother's reign he undertook public duties, but she excluded him from acting as her deputy until 1898.

body.zh-Hant: 1901年1月22日，母親維多利亞女王去世，59歲的愛德華繼位為國王。加冕典禮原訂1902年6月26日舉行，但僅兩天前他因闌尾炎須緊急手術，只得延至8月9日。
body.en: On 22 January 1901, on the death of his mother Queen Victoria, Edward became King at the age of 59. The coronation was set for 26 June 1902, but only two days beforehand he was forced to postpone it until 9 August because of appendicitis requiring an emergency operation.

body.zh-Hant: 愛德華的主要興趣在外交與軍事、海軍事務。他通曉法語與德語，與歐陸幾乎所有君主有親戚關係，被稱為「歐洲的叔父」；1904年他訪問法國，此行有助營造日後英法協約得以成形的氣氛。他也積極推動軍事與海軍改革，催促改革陸軍醫療勤務並使本土艦隊現代化。
body.en: Edward's main interests lay in foreign affairs and in military and naval matters. Fluent in French and German, he was related to nearly every Continental sovereign and became known as the 'Uncle of Europe'; his 1904 visit to France helped create the atmosphere that made the Anglo-French entente cordiale possible. He also encouraged military and naval reforms, pressing for reform of the Army Medical Service and modernisation of the Home Fleet.

body.zh-Hant: 在生命最後一年，愛德華捲入憲政危機：保守黨占多數的上議院拒絕通過自由黨1909年的預算案。他在自由黨於1910年選舉獲勝、危機解決之前去世，卒於1910年5月6日，享年68歲，遺體停靈西敏廳；5月20日葬於溫莎聖喬治禮拜堂，由其子喬治繼位。
body.en: In the last year of his life Edward was caught up in the constitutional crisis caused by the refusal of the Conservative majority in the Lords to pass the Liberal budget of 1909. He died on 6 May 1910, aged 68, before the Liberal election victory of 1910 could resolve the situation; he lay in state at Westminster Hall and was buried on 20 May in St George's Chapel, Windsor. His son George became King.

body.zh-Hant: 納里曼·納里曼諾夫1870年4月14日生於提夫里斯（今第比利斯）。1885年他進入哥里的外高加索教師講習所，1890年6月畢業，被派往提夫里斯省吉濟爾哈吉利村任教師；1891年來到巴庫，繼續教學與啟蒙工作。
body.en: Nariman Narimanov was born in Tiflis on 14 April 1870. He entered the Transcaucasian Teachers Seminary in Gori in 1885 and graduated in June 1890, when he was appointed teacher in the village of Gizil Hajili in the Tiflis province. In 1891 he came to Baku and continued his teaching and enlightenment activities.

heading.zh-Hant: 社民黨活動、行醫與流放
heading.en: Social Democratic activity, medicine and exile

body.zh-Hant: 1905年他在巴庫加入社會民主黨組織「胡梅特」。1908年他從敖德薩大學醫學系畢業，回巴庫在市立醫院任醫師；1909年因警方追捕前往第比利斯，同年3月因革命活動被捕，約半年後被流放阿斯特拉罕，1913年7月15日才回到巴庫。1917年4至12月他主持「胡梅特」成員會議，並當選該組織委員會主席。
body.en: In 1905 he joined the Hummet Social Democratic organisation in Baku. After graduating from the medical faculty of Odessa University in 1908 he returned to Baku and worked as a doctor in a city hospital. In 1909, pursued by the police, he left for Tbilisi, was arrested in March for revolutionary activity and about six months later was exiled to Astrakhan; he returned to Baku on 15 July 1913. From April to December 1917 he chaired meetings of the members of Hummet and was elected chairman of its committee.

body.zh-Hant: 1919年6月底，俄共中央召他到莫斯科；1919年7月至1920年5月他在莫斯科擔任數項職務，包括俄羅斯聯邦外交人民委員部近東司司長、民族事務副人民委員。
body.en: At the end of June 1919 the Central Committee of the Russian Communist Party summoned him to Moscow. From July 1919 to May 1920 he held several posts there, including head of the Middle East Department of the RSFSR People's Commissariat for Foreign Affairs and Deputy People's Commissar for Nationalities.

body.zh-Hant: 1920年4月27日亞塞拜然臨時革命委員會成立，他缺席當選主席；4月28日亞塞拜然蘇維埃社會主義共和國人民委員會成立，他被任命為人民委員會主席兼外交人民委員。據該部說明，他自1920年4月28日至1922年3月12日擔任革命委員會、人民委員會與國防委員會主席。Altstadt指出，他當時不在巴庫，也不確定他是否支持以此方式建立蘇維埃政權。
body.en: On 27 April 1920, when the Interim Revolutionary Committee of Azerbaijan was formed, he was elected its chairman in absentia; on 28 April the Council of People's Commissars of the Azerbaijan SSR was organised and he was appointed its chairman and People's Commissar for Foreign Affairs. According to the Azerbaijani foreign ministry he served as chairman of the Revolutionary Committee, the Council of People's Commissars and the Council of Defense from 28 April 1920 to 12 March 1922. Altstadt notes that he was not in Baku at the time and that it is not clear he supported installing Soviet power by this means.

heading.zh-Hant: 熱那亞會議、蘇聯中央執行委員會與去世
heading.en: Genoa Conference, the USSR Central Executive Committee and death

body.zh-Hant: 1922年他是蘇聯代表團成員，參加熱那亞國際會議；Altstadt寫道，他因反對把亞塞拜然、亞美尼亞與喬治亞合併為外高加索聯邦等政策，1922年被調離巴庫，名義上是「升任」莫斯科職務。外交部傳記稱，1922年12月蘇聯第一屆蘇維埃代表大會成立的中央執行委員會首次會議上，他代表外高加索聯邦當選蘇聯中央執行委員會主席。他1925年3月19日在莫斯科去世，官方說法為心臟衰弱，也有學者認為他可能遭人下毒。
body.en: In 1922 he took part in the Genoa Conference as a member of the Soviet delegation. Altstadt writes that his opposition to key policies, among them merging Azerbaijan, Armenia and Georgia into a Transcaucasian Federation, led to his removal from Baku in 1922, euphemised as a 'promotion' to a post in Moscow. The Azerbaijani foreign ministry's biography says he was elected Chairman of the Central Executive Committee of the USSR from the Transcaucasian SFSR at its first session in December 1922. He died in Moscow on 19 March 1925, allegedly of a weak heart; some scholars believe he may have been poisoned.

heading.en: Coming to power in 1903 and first administration

body.zh-Hant: 1903年，曼努埃爾·博尼利亞將軍推翻試圖延長任期的總統西耶拉。他是保守派，與自由黨前總統波利卡爾波·博尼利亞是對手而非親友，任內把後者囚禁兩年多並壓制自由黨反對派。他也試圖把保守派整編為「國民黨」，今日的洪都拉斯國民黨追溯其起源到他的政府（該書另稱該黨1902年由他從自由黨分裂出來所創）。
body.en: In 1903 General Manuel Bonilla overthrew President Sierra, whose efforts to perpetuate himself in office had provoked the coup. A Conservative, he was an opponent of the Liberal former president Policarpo Bonilla, whom he imprisoned for over two years while suppressing the Liberal opposition. He also tried to reorganise the Conservatives into a 'national party'; the present-day National Party of Honduras traces its origins to his administration (the same work also says the party was formed in 1902 by Bonilla as a splinter group of the Liberals).

body.zh-Hant: 博尼利亞比前任更是香蕉公司之友：公司獲得免稅、建造碼頭與道路的許可，並可取得新鐵路的特許。他也推動內部建設，尤其修路，改善了從特古西加爾巴到太平洋沿岸的路線。對外，他先與尼加拉瓜、後與瓜地馬拉和薩爾瓦多締結友好條約，並在任內劃定與尼加拉瓜長期有爭議的邊界。
body.en: Bonilla proved an even greater friend of the banana companies than his predecessor: they gained tax exemptions, permission to build wharves and roads, and charters for new railroads. He promoted internal improvements, notably road building, improving the route from Tegucigalpa to the Pacific coast. Abroad he concluded friendship pacts with Nicaragua and later with Guatemala and El Salvador, and his administration worked to delineate the long-disputed border with Nicaragua.

body.zh-Hant: 1906年博尼利亞成功擋住來自瓜地馬拉的入侵，但這是他最後一次重大成功。尼加拉瓜總統塞拉亞支持流亡的洪都拉斯自由派，他們於1907年2月入侵並成立臨時軍政府；博尼利亞在薩爾瓦多軍隊協助下抵抗，3月仍被擊潰。美國海軍調停之下，他在阿馬帕拉的最後據點失守，登上美艦芝加哥號尋求庇護。
body.en: In 1906 Bonilla successfully resisted an invasion from Guatemala, but this was his last major success. Nicaragua's President Zelaya supported exiled Honduran Liberals, who invaded in February 1907 and set up a provisional junta; with Salvadoran troops' help Bonilla tried to resist but was decisively beaten in March. After negotiations conducted by the US naval commander, he sought refuge on the U.S.S. Chicago from his last position at Amapala.

body.zh-Hant: 1911年洪都拉斯爆發反對總統達維拉的起事，美國出面調停，雙方在美國軍艦上會談。叛軍由前總統曼努埃爾·博尼利亞領導，與政府同意停火，並由美方調停人道森挑選臨時總統；道森選了弗朗西斯科·貝特朗，達維拉辭職。博尼利亞贏得1912年選舉，但任職僅一年多就去世；原副總統貝特朗回任總統。
body.en: In 1911 an uprising against President Dávila broke out and the United States mediated, bringing both sides to a conference on a warship. The revolutionaries, headed by former president Manuel Bonilla, agreed with the government to a cease-fire and to a provisional president chosen by the US mediator, Thomas Dawson; Dawson selected Francisco Bertrand and Dávila resigned. Bonilla won the 1912 elections but died after just over a year in office, and Bertrand, his vice president, returned to the presidency.
